meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把记忆文件或待办清单压成极简格式，省下输入字数，同时留一份好读的备份
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 agent 记忆文件越写越长、每次都要多花词元，又不想丢掉原文
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent memory file keeps growing, costs more tokens each run, and you still want the original kept

howto.what: 运行后,它把 CLAUDE.md、待办清单等自然语言文件压成短句(穴居人语)以省输入 token,压缩版覆盖原文件,可读备份存到源码树外的备份数据目录。代码块、路径、命令等原样保留。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman-compress 加文件路径,或要求压缩某个记忆文件时触发。只管自然语言文件(.md、.txt 等),代码类文件不改。

say.note: 压缩该文件,原文件先备份再被覆盖

say.text: 帮我把 CLAUDE.md 压成穴居人语,省点 token
say.note: 走同一流程,跑脚本后返回结果

say.text: 压缩 ./todos.md,里面的代码块别动
say.note: 代码块与行内代码原样复制不改

howto.what_en: When run, it compresses natural-language files like CLAUDE.md or todo lists into caveman-speak to save input tokens. The compressed version overwrites the original; a readable backup goes to an out-of-tree data dir. Code blocks, paths and commands stay exact.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /caveman-compress plus a filepath, or when you ask to compress a memory file. Only natural-language files (.md, .txt, etc.); code files are never modified.

say_en.note: Backs up the original, then overwrites it

say_en.text: Compress CLAUDE.md into caveman speak to save tokens
